nameOrigin: great pleasure (often in relation to food)

pokedexEntries.bk: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

pokedexEntries.wh: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

pokedexEntries.x: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

pokedexEntries.or: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

pokedexEntries.y: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

pokedexEntries.as: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

pokedexEntries.su: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.

pokedexEntries.mo: It feels pleasantly cool when embraced. This Pokémon is treasured by households in warm regions.

pokedexEntries.us: It exhales cold air that is at –58 degrees Fahrenheit. When it’s in a warm place, it shrinks little by little.

pokedexEntries.um: When the morning sun hit an icicle, it wished not to melt, and thus Vanillite was born. At night, it buries itself in snow to sleep.

pokedexEntries.sw: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

pokedexEntries.sh: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

pokedexEntries.za: The temperature of their breath is −58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
